name: Global Sum Bound Reduction
description: Replaces a local edge-wise constraint with a global sum of pairwise bitwise XORs that must equal its theoretical maximum. Models must deduce that the maximum can only be achieved if every single edge contributes its maximum (3), which requires opposite modes, before they can recognize the underlying graph coloring structure. Superficial pattern matchers may misinterpret the global sum as a Max-Cut or DP optimization problem.
